blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Issues against Vice President Sara Duterte have gone beyond mere non-declaration in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) and have escalated to a national security concern, House prosecution spokesperson Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said. In a press briefing on Tuesday after Duterte’s impeachment trial, Alonto Adiong described the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) confirmation of financial transactions from accounts in China to Cale88 Foods Corporation—a company owned by the Vice President’s husband, Manases Carpio—“worrisome.” AMLC Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura testified on Monday that Cale88 got over P319 million worth of inward transactions from companies based […]...
